svg.title: Tombstoning: potential causes
svg.desc: Training analysis. Source branch order and causal arrows preserved. Top branches left to right: Environment, People, Materials. Bottom branches left to right: Methods, Equipment. Potential causes are hypotheses for investigation.

text.tspan: Material bag too tight during preparation
Unequal pad sizes, oxidized pads or
Stencil apertures do not match pads,
Placement displacement: coordinate displacement, faulty nozzle or insufficient
Incorrect reflow temperature or excessive transport speed
